notes.title: Announcement: Tokyo Game Show 2025
notes.notes: [p]We are happy to announce that DRIFTED will be exhibiting at Tokyo Game Show 2025, held at Makuhari Messe.[/p][p]The game will be playable at our booth UrbanFox, along with the other game we are also developing now, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3596320/"]THE SCREEN[/url].[/p][p]DRIFTED demo will also be featured at Konami Digital Entertainment's booth this year as an official selection from Indie Games Contest. As an IGDA Japan scholarship member, the game is also playable at IGDA Japan's booth, along with other selected games.[/p][p]In addition to the gameplay, we are also showcasing some postcards from in-game screenshots. Be sure to check them out![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850983/81f61dcc356b2aa2b17ba634dba930e4fc65338a.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Booth Information[/h2][p][/p][p]DRIFTED demo is playable at 3 booths:[/p][list][*][p][b]UrbanFox[/b] | 11-C09[/p][/*][*][p][b]Konami Digital Entertainment[/b] | 05-S01[/p][/*][*][p][b]IGDA Japan[/b] | 11-E35[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Tokyo Game Show 2025 - Information[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Event Website[/b][/p][p][url="https://tgs.cesa.or.jp/jp"]https://tgs.cesa.or.jp/jp[/url][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Event Dates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Business Days:[/p][list][*][p]September 25th (THU) 10:00 – 17:00[/p][/*][*][p]September 26th (FRI) 10:00 – 17:00[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Public Days:[/p][list][*][p]September 27th (SAT) 9:30 – 17:00[/p][/*][*][p]September 28th (SUN) 9:30 – 16:30[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]About UrbanFox[/h2][p][/p][p]UrbanFox is a game developer with multiple awards and exhibition experiences internationally, including gamescom, Tokyo Game Show, the Japan iGi indie Game incubator Special Award, the Bahamut ACG Creation Contest Gold Award, and more.[/p][p]They are currently developing DRIFTED and THE SCREEN.[/p][p align="start"][/p]
